facts.label: Identity JWT
facts.description: Shared platform verifier: issuer/audience/time/signature; fixed-origin JWKS only. Time is checked after discovery.

facts.label: JWKS limits
facts.description: Refresh240s, минимум30s между попытками. Один fetch; concurrent requests используют свежие ключи или сразу503, без ожидания monitor. После expiry outage даёт503.

facts.label: PostgreSQL transaction
facts.description: Existing-profile reads run concurrently under a shared account lock. Deletion/mutation/bootstrap use exclusive ownership; missing-profile reads release shared ownership before rechecking tombstones and bootstrap.

facts.label: Повтор команды
facts.description: Неизменяемые request fingerprint и response в одной транзакции; changed payload даёт 409.

facts.label: Current goal
facts.description: Новая ручная цель создаёт immutable version; newest same-date revision wins. Nutrition и hydration revisions независимы от Profile.version и aggregate_version. Дата читает только timezone.

facts.label: Версии профиля и событий
facts.description: Profile.version меняется только при PATCH профиля; каждое событие получает account-wide aggregate_version. Nutrition и hydration имеют независимые revision counters. V003 сохраняет старые версии и историю.

facts.label: Outbox delivery
facts.description: Fencing token, SKIP LOCKED; retries 1s–5min с jitter, per-item failures isolated.

facts.label: Onboarding
facts.description: User хранит принятые цели. Health calculation, manual-weight idempotency и workload policy ещё нужны; onboardingCompleted остаётся false.

facts.label: Доступ к User
facts.description: Production gateway пока не маршрутизирует /v1/me/*. Production deployment не активирован.

flows.title: Прочитать профиль и цели
flows.description: Проверенный JWT задаёт account scope. Позднее первое обращение может создать incomplete profile.

steps.label: Public HTTP
steps.detail: GET /v1/me/*; no-store response. Доступный User runtime; production ingress ещё не активирован.

steps.label: Identity public keys
steps.detail: Shared fixed-origin JWKS verifier; verified access JWT, no trusted owner headers. Refresh does not block other request threads.

steps.label: Read / lazy bootstrap
steps.detail: Shared account lock and one deletion/existence query; existing profiles skip bootstrap writes. Missing profile releases shared ownership, then exclusive bootstrap rechecks deletion before owner-scoped read. Historical activation may have expired.

flows.title: Изменить профиль или цель
flows.description: Идемпотентная команда сохраняет state и outbox атомарно.

steps.label: Verify and validate
steps.detail: Identity subject, strict JSON, generated DTO → domain command.

steps.label: Single commit
steps.detail: Exclusive account lock; key/fingerprint replay or mutation; profile-only version/cheat-day conflict. Independent profile, goal/hydration revision and account event counters commit with state + outbox + stored response.

flows.title: Доставить события User
flows.description: Реальный User producer; Progress остаётся planned. Notification читает профиль.

steps.label: Claim one row
steps.detail: SKIP LOCKED; 30s lease + token. Payload immutable.

steps.label: Publish with ACK
steps.detail: Nats-Msg-Id=event_id; ACK deadline 10s; retry without losing independent rows.

steps.label: Profile projection
steps.detail: Existing consumer compares aggregate_version and updates locale only when not explicitly overridden. Timezone belongs to Notification.

flows.title: Активация и удаление User
flows.description: Identity lifecycle через JetStream: inbox + effects commit before ACK.

steps.label: Validate event
steps.detail: Envelope producer/type/subject/account IDs must agree; malformed input is metadata quarantine.

steps.label: Delete / activate under lock
steps.detail: Inbox and tombstone/erasure are atomic. Late activation cannot resurrect; profile data and pending outbox erased.

steps.label: ACK after commit
steps.detail: Shared runner ACKs after handler/quarantine commit. Transient failures retry with equal jitter up to300s; quarantine/ACK/NAK failure cannot abort a healthy next item.
